name: create_danmaku_report
description: Render and privately store an HTML report using a danmaku analysis evidence_id for any authorized video_id. Sample excerpts are already grouped by exact text after redaction. sections_json is a JSON array (max 6) of {title,observation,recommendation,sample_ids:[string IDs]}, each observation cites 1-4 available canonical sample IDs; every sampled source ID remains available. Empty array allowed for no reliable observations. Do not interpret sampled duplicate count as full-room frequency, or invent numeric topic/sentiment ratios or causation. Successful execution delivers the report and ends the run. Optionally attach video_evidence_id from analyze_video_content for the SAME video; the server adds a time-anchored video evidence section. Never put video evidence IDs in sample_ids.
